script_text:
Stop, Aries! Today’s fire is about to hit Saturn’s invisible wall.
Saturn nears opposition to Aries from your 12th House, exposing hidden obligations. Venus is conjunct the Sun in your 7th House, while your cardinal fire nature, ruled by Mars, favors clear intentions over romantic guessing games.
If you’re single, a warm, articulate person could cross your path today; notice someone who initiates and keeps their word. If you’re taken, one partner may need more reassurance than usual, so replace assumptions with a direct question.
That Saturn–Aries opposition activates your 6th House of Work through the 12th, making today’s biggest money risk an unclear deadline. Check every promise and get any extra responsibility confirmed in writing before agreeing.
Avoid quietly working unpaid extra hours simply to prove your loyalty.
Follow for tomorrow’s reading; don’t miss the Aries shift next week.
